title: Google Ads for Movers - Declare Media

facts.fact: Declare Media states that on average a person moves every ~5 years or so, and a person with a family moves even less frequently.
facts.quote: On average a person moves every ~5 years or so and a person with a family even less frequently.

facts.fact: Declare Media says moving companies pay $20-40 per qualified, in-market lead from Google Ads.
Declare Media says a moving company books 65% of leads into paying jobs.
facts.quote: You book 65% of leads into paying jobs.

facts.fact: Declare Media uses an assumed average move cost of around $1,200, which it describes as conservative.
facts.quote: Let’s say your average move cost is around $1,200.

facts.fact: In Declare Media's California moving company case study, the company spends around $3,000 per month on Google Ads.
facts.quote: spends around $3,000 per month on Google Ads

facts.fact: In Declare Media's California moving company case study, the company generated 651 leads at $36.35 per lead.
facts.quote: Note the 651 leads at $36.35 per lead.

facts.fact: In Declare Media's California case study, the company closes roughly 65% of its leads.
facts.quote: They are closing roughly 65% of those leads

facts.fact: In Declare Media's California case study, the company won about 423 jobs from $23,664 in ad spend during the stated time frame.
facts.quote: that’s about 423 jobs from $23,664 in spend during this time frame

facts.fact: In Declare Media's California case study, the average move is around $1,100 in the towns the company operates in.
facts.quote: The average move is around $1,100 in the towns they operate in.

facts.fact: Declare Media's California case study calculates $465,300 in revenue from 423 jobs at an average of $1,100 per job.
facts.quote: 423 jobs \* $1,100 per job (on average) = $465,300 in revenue.
